summary: Added extractLedgerRoot(val: unknown): string | undefined helper to work-package.ts. Replaces the repeated 5x inline typeof guard with a named utility that also protects against the MCP SDK injecting RequestHandlerExtra objects (constraint 58).

Extended propagateDependencyUnblock and propagateDependencyReblock signatures: third parameter changed from ledgerRoot?: string to ledgerRootOrOpts?: string | { store: LedgerStore }. When opts.store is provided, construction is skipped and the provided store is used directly. String form preserved for backward compatibility.

Updated 2 call sites in work-package.ts (propagateDependencyUnblock + propagateDependencyReblock) and 1 in pipeline.ts (propagateDependencyUnblock) to pass { store } instead of ledgerRoot, eliminating the redundant store construction.

Updated api-surface.md signatures for both functions, added extractLedgerRoot documentation, and corrected a pre-existing doc error where propagateDependencyReblock was shown with a different signature.
tsc --noEmit exits 0. 982 tests pass.

comments.note: The api-surface.md had an inconsistency before this WP: propagateDependencyReblock was documented with 'store: LedgerStore' as a required 3rd positional argument (not the actual signature). The actual implementation took 'ledgerRoot?: string'. This WP corrected both the implementation and the doc simultaneously.
